title: Actual compact supports commute with ordinary constructible coefficient realization
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$, its algebraic closure $k$, and $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k_0)$. Write $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. For each finite-type $k$-scheme $T$, on its small pro-etale site put $B_T=\Omega_T^{\mathrm{lf}}$, the sheaf of continuous $\Omega$-valued functions whose values locally span a finite-dimensional $\mathbf Q_\ell$-space. Put $\mathcal A_T=\operatorname{Mod}(B_T)$, with the internal-module convention of [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework], and let $\mathcal C_T\subset D(\mathcal A_T)$ be the full subcategory with bounded constructible cohomology: each cohomology sheaf is locally finite free on every member of a finite locally closed stratification, locally on $T$. Let $\mathcal C^{\mathrm{stage}}_{T,\Omega}=D^b_{ctf}(T,\Omega)$ be the ordinary common finite coefficient-field category of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]: objects are represented over one finite $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ in $\Omega$, and morphisms are the filtered colimit of the scalar-extended Hom groups over common finite extensions. At $E$ use raw rationalization of derived-complete integral constructible complexes [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. Use the scalar-extension realization $J_T$ of [lem-sf-locally-finite-adic-constructible-realization]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be separated of finite type, with $X,Y$ finite-type over $k$ but not necessarily separated over $k$. Choose a compactification $c=(j:X\hookrightarrow Z,p:Z\to Y)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Let $F^{\mathrm{stage}}=Rf_{!,\Omega}$ be the common-stage compact-support functor [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], and $F^c=Rp_*D(j_!)$ the actual module-sheaf derived functor. The canonical scalar-extension comparison is a natural isomorphism of ordinary derived functors
$$\alpha_c:J_YF^{\mathrm{stage}}\xrightarrow{\sim}F^cJ_X.$$
It is the composite of the open-extension comparison $J_Zj_!^{\mathrm{stage}}\to j_!J_X$ and the proper comparison $J_YRp_*^{\mathrm{stage}}\to Rp_*J_Z$, restricted to these constructible inputs. The formula specifies its action on localized derived morphisms, not just cohomology groups. In particular $F^c$ carries $\mathcal C_X$ into $\mathcal C_Y$.

proof.text: Use native_compact_support_geometry to choose the exact native section transport.
Use locally_finite_compact_support_stage_action to construct the rational action with exactly the specified P finite functors and q.

Use native_compact_support_finite_comparison for these data. This supplies the compatible coefficient maps and normalized isomorphisms on each rational finite stage, with their isoToStage compatibility.

At a pair A=(E,K), define alpha_A by the E-stage isomorphism on K. Every arrow has a representative u at a common stage L. Factor it as isoToStage(A), inclusion_L(u), and inverse isoToStage(B). The transition equations give naturality on the two outer factors; the finite-stage isomorphism gives naturality on the middle one. Cancel the transition isomorphisms to prove naturality on the representative. NatIso.ofComponents gives the natural isomorphism on the original common-stage category. Every component is definitionally its prescribed finite-stage component. Apply the finite comparison normalization certificate to these component equalities, yielding the unchanged IntegralNormalization predicate and its six-arrow equation on every integral representative.

For a native bounded constructible K, the source realization image clause supplies A and an isomorphism source.J(A) ≅ K. Then alpha_A followed by actual.mapIso of this isomorphism identifies target.J(stage.functor(A)) with actual(K). The target image clause therefore proves native bounded constructibility of actual(K). This also applies to zero objects and empty schemes; no absolute separatedness is introduced.
